job.title: [Post] ROYAL CYBER, WE'RE HIRING *SFCC Architect* Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud SFRA ReactJS Comp…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Architect | Java, Spring, API Integration & PWA Expertise
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and headless integrations. Designed and executed PWA-enabled storefronts, data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, and CI/CD deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal. Proven techno-functional consultant bridging business analysis, user stories and production support for global teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SFCC Architect Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud SFRA ReactJS Composable Storefront (PWA Kit)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Royal Cyber’s commitment to innovative commerce solutions and the remote-first model. With over 5 years designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless APIs, PWA integration and large-scale e-commerce integrations that align perfectly with the SFCC Architect role.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and exposed OCC REST web services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration between ERP, MDM and storefronts.

bullets.label: Headless PWA Enablement
bullets.text: Implemented headless commerce APIs and PWA-enabled storefronts, delivering fast, responsive user experiences across devices.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Bridged business and IT by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and guiding global teams through production support.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Deployment
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, guaranteeing reliable releases.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Royal Cyber’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge, composable commerce experiences aligns with my passion for building scalable, headless e-commerce platforms. The opportunity to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to Salesforce B2C projects, collaborate with international teams, and contribute to innovative SFRA and PWA-Kit solutions excites me and matches my career goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive innovative, headless commerce solutions at Royal Cyber.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering headless e-commerce and PWA integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to bring my API and integration expertise to Royal Cyber’s SFCC Architect role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SFCC Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SFCC Architect position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in Java, Spring, headless APIs and PWA integrations. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Royal Cyber.
